description.value:
Thanks to Militech, this legendary warrior is reborn! That’s what the ads say, anyway. They probably just found an old NUS warehouse full of ‘em and stuck a logo on. While this carbine is far from its prime, and its ammo fails to perform against modern armor, in the hands of a skilled user its bursts can be seriously destructive.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Class: Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Carbine

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Extended Magazine, Short Scope • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load Basic Ammunition. When firing this weapon, the user must choose one of the following firing modes to use: Burst (3), Burst (6), or Burst (9).

Burst (3) expends 3 rounds and has all expended ammunition also function as Armor-Piercing Ammunition.

Burst (6) expends 6 rounds and has all expended ammunition also function as Explosive Ammunition, including its -2 Attack Check penalty and inability to make Aimed Shots.

Burst (9) expends 9 rounds and deals 1d6 additional damage (5d6).

All firing modes take on the bonuses and penalties (but not the ammo expenditure) of the ones preceding them (e.g., Burst (9) has all the features of Burst (3) and Burst (6), but only expends 9 rounds). This weapon cannot fire if there are less than 3 rounds in the magazine. This weapon is incompatible with any variation of Burst Mod Internals.

Range: Carbine
Pre-installed: Extended Magazine, Short Scope (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
